system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: L1 — Index** | Lives in the system prompt | The model on every turn | 3 lines / ~60 tokens per skill
system_prompt_style.note: Only the README and file tree are in the bundle. The system prompt includes an L1 block for each installed skill, so its content depends on the skills installed. The prompt-building code (src/context.ts) was not in the bundle, so no line number is cited.

env_context_strategy.note: Inferred from the file tree, which lists glob, grep, ls and read tools. No context injection is described. The tool sources were not opened.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Long sessions auto-compress history; tokens never overflow, memory never lost
context_compaction.note: The README marks live compaction as beta and does not describe the mechanism. Summarize is inferred from the phrase 'memory never lost'.

observation_format.note: The code that converts tool results into model messages was not in the bundle.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: // What the model sees in its tools list — just one Bash:
tool_call_format.note: The model emits Bash({command}) through a tools list. Skill verbs are shell-style commands inside the Bash tool. shell_only was not added because the file tree also lists non-shell tools.

tool_count.note: The README says the model sees 'just one Bash' tool, but src/tools lists bash, edit, glob, grep, ls, read, skillCall and write, plus src/subagent/agentTool.ts. The tools/index.ts registry was not in the bundle, so the count cannot be confirmed.

edit_primitive.note: src/tools/edit.ts and write.ts exist, but their contents were not in the bundle.

tool_schema_source.note: The code that produces tool schemas was not in the bundle.

protocol_standardization.note: The README mentions MCP only as a comparison skill type. No dependency list or source code was available to grep.

loop_primitives.note: The file tree lists loops named chain, evaluator, orchestrator, parallel, route and simple. These may make fixed_pipeline, generate_test_repair or multi_attempt reachable, but none of the loop code was in the bundle. Treating simple as the default is an assumption.

planning_granularity.note: No plan object or prompt recipe appears in the bundle.

multi_agent_topology.note: src/subagent/ exists, including agentTool.ts and builtinAgents.ts. Whether sub-agents are enabled by default is not visible.

delegation_mechanism.note: src/subagent/runAgent.ts suggests a subagent_spawn mechanism, but the default configuration was not visible.

human_in_loop.note: Inferred from the permission prompt UI file and from install-time capability grants. The default policy was not visible.

short_term_state.note: The agent state code was not in the bundle.

long_term_memory.note: Installed skills persist under ~/.yome/skills, and each skill's L1 entry is injected into the system prompt. Threads store session history, but no re-injection into later runs is shown.

state_persistence.note: Threads are stored and src/ui/SessionPicker.tsx exists, but no resume code path was visible.

self_verification.note: src/loops/evaluator.ts exists, but its content and default status were not visible.

retry_policy.note: The run loop was not in the bundle.

rollback.note: 'yome skill rollback' undoes skill installs, not changes made during a run.

termination_condition.note: The run loop was not in the bundle.

cost_controls.note: src/llm.ts was not in the bundle.

timeouts.note: src/tools/bash.ts was not in the bundle.

execution_isolation.note: Commands run on the host shell. Skills run AppleScript on the local machine.

filesystem_access.note: The README describes fs capabilities for skills only. Filesystem limits for the Bash and write tools were not visible.

network_policy.note: A 'network' capability is declared for skills. The network policy for plain shell commands was not visible.

permission_model.note: Per-skill capabilities are granted at install time. src/permissions/ruleParser.ts suggests a rule system, but the default rules were not visible.

tracing.note: Threads store session history, but the storage format was not visible.

replayability.note: No replay code was visible in the bundle.

eval_hooks.note: No source code was available to search for evaluation hooks.

guardrails.evidence_quote: This is not "asking for permission" in a prompt — it is a real sandbox gate
guardrails.note: src/redact.ts redacts case bundles for sharing. It does not filter model output.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Drives native apps via AppleScript / Win32 / DBus
target_domain.note: The system targets desktop productivity apps through native skills.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: export YOME_PROVIDER=anthropic # or openai (auto-detected from base URL)
model_agnostic.note: Supports the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs with a configurable base URL.
